title.zh-TW: 註冊成功享總價值 NT$100 折扣優惠
title.en: Discounts worth NT$100 in total after you register

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（推薦碼 6GZI4 已包含在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (referral code 6GZI4 is already part of it).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 App 並完成註冊；若註冊時要求推薦碼，請輸入 6GZI4。
steps.en: Download the app and register as the page asks; if it asks for a referral code, enter 6GZI4.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊成功後，依活動規則取得折扣優惠。
steps.en: After registering, receive the discounts under the campaign rules.

intro.zh-TW: 使用推薦碼 6GZI4 完成下載並成功註冊，即可享有總價值 NT$100 的折扣優惠。
intro.en: Download the app and register with referral code 6GZI4 to receive discounts worth NT$100 in total.

description.zh-TW: Gogoro GoShare 是透過手機 App 使用的共享機車服務。本站邀請連結已含推薦碼 6GZI4，點擊「立即註冊」後依頁面指示下載 App 並註冊；若要求輸入推薦碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）填入。依平台分享文案，註冊成功可享總價值 NT$100 的折扣優惠，實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。註冊前請確認連結網域屬於 ridegoshare.com。
description.en: Gogoro GoShare is a scooter-sharing service that you use through a mobile app. The invite link on this page already contains referral code 6GZI4, so after selecting “Sign up” you only need to download the app and register as the page asks; if it asks for a referral code, enter 6GZI4 exactly as shown, including capitalization. The platform's share text mentions discounts worth NT$100 in total after you register, but the actual content, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements. Before you register, check that the link's domain belongs to ridegoshare.com.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼 6GZI4 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。折扣的使用條件與期限以官方說明為準。
notes.en: Referral code 6GZI4 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. Conditions and deadlines for the discounts follow the official terms.
